summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting routine weekly updates under an existing open-market share repurchase programme announced on 6 May 2026, part of a broader up-to-DKK 15 billion buyback running from 4 February 2026. The filing details daily repurchases of B shares from 15-19 June 2026 at average prices between DKK 282.33 and DKK 293.48, accumulating 6,200,000 shares under the programme. This is an ordinary issuer repurchase disclosure, not a special situation. No tender offer, privatization, or structural change is announced; it is a standard capital return program.
